source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //! DiffLocks' artists drew 75 base hairstyles by hand in Blender, each about

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //! fifty guide strands giving only "the overall shape and direction of the

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //! hair"; the randomisation adds everything else. Those guides are not

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //! published. Here a base style is three independent choices -- the

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //! [`Follicles`] (which way hair grows), the [`Haircut`] (how long it is)

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
source prose/documentation
source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //! * **Out of the scalp.** A strand leaves its follicle the way it is

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //!   combed, at the follicle's angle to the scalp (lifted as the style lifts

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //!   it), and rises over a few centimetres to its layer: the hair under it.

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //!   (Which way the follicle itself points shows in the first centimetre of

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //!   every strand, [`crate::ops::Orient`], and in how hair lies where the

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //!   style leaves it as it grows.) Hair rooted higher up -- nearer the part

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //!   or the crown -- lies over hair rooted lower down, so the layer's height

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //!   grows from nothing at the hairline to the style's volume at the top.

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //! * **On the head.** Lying on its layer, a strand follows the style's comb

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //!   (away from a part, back, forward, to a tie, or as it grows), turned

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //!   into the layer's tangent plane, and slides downhill as much as the

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //!   hair still to come weighs on it: long hair on the side of the head

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //!   runs down it, short hair keeps the way it was combed. In front of the

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //!   face, hair keeps to its comb until it is past the face.

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //! * **Off the head.** Free -- past the head's widest, or lifted off it -- a

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //!   strand is a cantilever: gravity bends it with the curvature a rod's own

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //!   weight gives, `(L - s)^2 / (2 L_g^3)` for `L - s` of it still to come

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //!   or curly lock). Long hair drops straight down where it leaves the

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation

text_occurrences.text: //! Prism sweeps: halve the room of every triangle whose extruded prism

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //! would fold, in triangle order, pass after pass.

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //! Within a pass each triangle sees the halvings of the triangles before it,

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //! which makes the sweep sequential. Its outcome is nevertheless a fixed

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //! point: a triangle fails if and only if its prism fails with the room its

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //! vertices keep after the earlier failures. Only a triangle that fails with

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //! the pass's starting room, or that shares a vertex with a triangle that has

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //! failed, can fail at all. So a pass tests every triangle once in parallel,

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //! and one workgroup iterates the verdicts of just those candidates -- adding

text_occurrences.kind: source prose/documentation
text_occurrences.text: //! the neighbours of each new failure -- until none changes. A pass in which

admission_inventory.invariant: A native texture extent is an input to grid admission, not proof of a flattened-u32 population or coherent native resource wrapper.
all_admission_routes: Texture2d Default admits missing resources/size0; public size/texture/view/format/usage fields allow independent struct literals/mutation; create rejectsNaN and checks castwidth,height>=1 and native per-axis max.
Texture3d Default/mutablepublicfields and new(Vec3) NaN rejection/max1nativeaxis normalization; provider handles native allocation validation.

Compute texture paths pattern-match GpuResource, bind selected resources, derive workgroup axes from actual selected output (Scatter from input). Map/Gather/Stencil/Scatter also compute raw flattened texture products.
admission_inventory.counterexample_or_proof: Valid per-axis3D values2048*2048*1024 require2^32 flattened entries; per-axis limits alone do not prove u32product. Publicly mismatched texture size/nativeview is another route, unrelated to WorkgroupGrid private tuple invariants. Zero default texture is an intentional missing state, not a reason to ban zero logical grids or collapse missing resource with rejected extent.
admission_inventory.disposition: F01/F04/F09: native/decoded extents must reach one canonical grid and checked flattened-count admission; coordinated #826/#774 resource coherence is required, not a local second texture implementation. Preserve existing2Dvs3D normalization/admission policies absent an explicit connected policy repair.

Bounds pair API receives pair indexes from original exact allocated pair count (one part/two boot layers), not arbitrary free pair values. Fairing stores2*n scalar radii then64 even ping-pong passes, write_at=n-read_at; final first-half read is justified by even pass count. Current bootn1641 gives3282 words; first authored ring40 and41 full rings plus sole fan remainder justify neighbor accesses for valid finite frame/carrier state. Sabaton shell_of derives exact PartLayout ranges; toe_shell=validated lame count3..8 matches appended toe cap. Last-carrier tip branch i+1 uses bounded generated part; clamped B-spline station index0..23 plus small signed offsets prevents native table overflow.

text_occurrences.kind: documentation/code/link text boundary

text_occurrences.kind: documentation/code/link text boundary

text_occurrences.kind: documentation/code/link text boundary
text_occurrences.text: Use one implementor for the ordinary reproduce/fix/render loop. The coordinating

text_occurrences.kind: documentation/code/link text boundary

No Default/Deserialize/raw native constructor or public mutation; Clone shares same actual resources. PartialEq compares code only and is not device authority. ComputePipeline::prepare checks actual shaderdevice then admits ReflectedInterface and private fields; new additionally compiles. clone shares immutabledefinition/cache, state perclone; compiled rejectsPrepared and ensuresdevice before lookup; get_or_create_pipeline devicecheck beforecache and nativeerrors retained. ReflectedInterface validates source, requirescompute entry, unions usedglobals/sampling overALL compute entries, rejectsusedImmediate beforebindingfilter, preserves sparsegroups under actual max_bind_groups. Uniform reflection accepts scalar32 Float/IntegerWord, floatVec2/3/4 andsquareMat2/3/4, rejectsunsupported structured content/multipleuniformblocks. ReflectionData/UniformMember fields are public mirrors, but public create_bind_groups takes immutable admitted ComputePipeline; private create_group is not externally reachable with fabricated public reflection, and FastPath construction private. Successful dispatch count remains number of recorded nonempty dispatches, not compilations/items/groups; copies and clears do not count. behavior_initial_observations.family: Static assembly and removed duplicate public implementation
behavior_initial_observations.trace: Old ComputePass inline packer and old separately public create_bind_groups implementation were not identical: old public helper omitted Unsigned and bound whole native allocations, while ComputePass supported Unsigned and logical prefixes. Search of actualbase990 finds no repository caller of public helper (organizer only). Both actual bodies now compared against shared assembly: new canonical path uses logical buffer prefix and typed zero/oversize rejection, supports Unsigned, retains actual reflected sparse index, selected view format/dimension/device and concrete causes. New static uniform allocation preserves DeviceExt copy alignment and trailing zero bytes, checks native allocation/uniform limits before host packing, allocates before write, and observes native causes when available. Missing uniform values still zero in static path; F23 shape narrowing/direct-member synthesis is a separate regression. Missing/kind/order of required buffers, textures and samplers remains sequential within each reflection group; device/layout/size checks may reject earlier as part of new ownership/admission contract.
behavior_initial_observations.disposition: No false blanket equivalence between old public helper and ComputePass. Canonical assembly must replace old duplicate; no new forwarding compatibility adapter. F23 and canonical byte metadata repair required.

behavior_initial_observations.trace: Actual old/new GroupBuilder full source: old reflected all bound globals; new ignores globals unused by all compute entries and builds union for all used entries. This can remove previously demanded unused parameters, an intended reflected-interface correctness change. prefix_connected_repair_plan.native_repair: Both native entry points consume canonical FOLDED_INDEX_WGSL for group-id flattening with width1. One shared native-source block guard computes ceil(count/BLOCK) by quotient+remainder without overflowing count+BLOCK-1. Reject the entire out-of-range workgroup before block*BLOCK. prefix_connected_repair_plan.native_proof: Fullu32 count has at most2^24 scan blocks. A valid block index is <=2^24-1; block*256+local_id.x<=u32MAX. The final partial block still runs all256 lanes and bounds-checks individual data accesses.
